propositions.name: aether_stationary_or_shared
propositions.statement: According to one theory the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion; the opposite theory of a stationary aether is favoured by other phenomena.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion. But other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether.

propositions.name: stellar_aberration_favours_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether.
propositions.quote: But other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether.

propositions.name: solids_deform_when_rotated
propositions.statement: Solid bodies alter their relative dimensions when rotated in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.
propositions.quote: the at first sight startling hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz that solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions, when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change

propositions.name: deformation_might_cause_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The deformation of matter when moving through the aether might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction.
propositions.quote: It occurred to me that such a deformation of matter when moving through the rather might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction

propositions.name: liquid_experiments_may_not_settle
propositions.statement: Experiments upon liquids may not really settle the matter of whether motion through the aether causes double refraction.
propositions.quote: But the question arises whether experiments upon liquids really settle the matter. Probably no complete answer can be given, unless in the light of some particular theory of these relations.

propositions.name: earth_motion_has_a_direction
propositions.statement: The earth has a motion whose direction at 12 o'clock is transverse to the board when the board stands north and south.
propositions.quote: When at 12 o'clock the board stands north and south, the earth's motion is transverse and the situation is such as to exhibit any double refraction which may ensue.

propositions.name: vibrations_directional_relative_to_motion
propositions.statement: Luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion may be propagated differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: It might be supposed, for instance, that luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, i. e. east and west, are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion

propositions.name: apparatus_shares_earth_motion
propositions.statement: When the board points east and west, both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, so the tube and its contents share the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: But if the board be turned through a right angle so as to point east and west, both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, and therefore no double refraction could manifest itself.

propositions.name: rotation_180_no_effect
propositions.statement: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180°.
propositions.quote: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180°, and such effect as a rotation through 90° may entail must be of the second order in the ratio

propositions.name: rotation_90_second_order
propositions.statement: The effect of a rotation through 90° must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.
propositions.quote: such effect as a rotation through 90° may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.

propositions.name: orbit_and_sun_motions_reckoned
propositions.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether the motion of the earth in its orbit and the motion of the sun in space must both be reckoned as motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: It should not be overlooked that according to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space.

propositions.name: sun_directed_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The motion of the sun in space is supposed to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules.
propositions.quote: The latter is supposed to be much the smaller, and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules.

propositions.name: april_motions_approximately_conspire
propositions.statement: In the month of April the two motions of the earth in its orbit and the sun in space would approximately conspire.
propositions.quote: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire.

propositions.name: displacement_of_band_evidences_effect
propositions.statement: The existence of double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether would be evidenced by a displacement of the dark band upwards or downwards.
propositions.quote: just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether, so that the existence of the latter would be evidenced by a displacement of the dark band upwards or downwards.

propositions.name: apparatus_forces_do_not_vary
propositions.statement: The gas-leading tubes give rise to no forces which could appreciably vary as the board turns.
propositions.quote: The gas-leading tubes are connected in such a manner as to give rise to no forces which could appreciably vary as the board turns.

propositions.name: time_between_observations_short
propositions.statement: The time required to pass from one observation to the other did not exceed 15 seconds.
propositions.quote: The time required to pass from one observation to the other did not exceed 15 seconds, and the alternate observations were repeated until it was quite certain that nothing could be detected.

propositions.name: board_positions_north_south_east_west
propositions.statement: The board can be set to the north-south position and to the east-west position, and the shift of the band was looked for on rotation between them whether at noon or at 6 p.m.
propositions.quote: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.

propositions.name: noon_and_6pm_are_different_configurations
propositions.statement: Observations at noon and at 6 p.m. probe different situations of the earth's motion relative to the board's position, so that a null result at both is stronger than at one.
propositions.quote: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.

propositions.name: horizontal_force_definite_value
propositions.statement: The earth's horizontal force is .18 in the C.G.S. unit and the rotation in CS 2 at 18° is .042 minute of angle for one unit of magnetic potential.
propositions.quote: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in CS 2 at 18° is .042 minute of angle. In the present case the length is 76 cms. and the earth's horizontal force is .18

propositions.name: plane_of_polarization_inclinable
propositions.statement: The light was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45°.
propositions.quote: was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45°

propositions.name: sin_squared_revival_law
propositions.statement: If θ be the angle of rotation of the nicol the revived light is sin²θ expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.
propositions.quote: If θ be this angle, the revived light is sin²θ, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.

propositions.name: half_lambda_equals_90_rotation
propositions.statement: If this retardation amounted to ½λ, λ being the wave-length, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90°.
propositions.quote: If this retardation amounted to ½λ, λ being the wave-length, the effect would be the same as of a rotation of the nicol through 90°.

propositions.name: phase_epsilon_gives_sin_squared_half
propositions.statement: A retardation of phase ε in place of π gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε), so that we may equate θ to ½ε.
propositions.quote: In general, a retardation of phase ε, in place of π, gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε). If the revivals of light in the two cases be the same, we may equate θ to ½ε.

propositions.name: strain_double_refraction_same_character
propositions.statement: The double refraction due to loads on the upright strip is of exactly the character to be tested for, so this method affords a very direct check.
propositions.quote: The double refraction due to the loads is of exactly the character to be tested for, and accordingly this method affords a very direct check.

propositions.name: load_50_gms_shifts_band
propositions.statement: The application of a total of 50 gms on a strip of 15 mm width caused a marked shifting of the band, while 25 gms was just perceptible with certainty.
propositions.quote: The strip actually employed had a width of 15 mm.; and the application (or removal) of a total of 50 gms. caused a marked shifting of the band, while 25 gms. was just perceptible with certainty.

propositions.name: wavelength_count_over_tube
propositions.statement: In 76 cm of bisulphide of carbon there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: In this length there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.

propositions.name: whole_retardation_reckoned_at_point_six
propositions.statement: The retardation due to the refraction may be reckoned at .6 of 2,400,000 half wave-lengths, or 1,440,000 half wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: The retardation due to the refraction may be reckoned at .6 of this, or 1,440,000 half wave-lengths.

propositions.name: expected_effect_of_order_10
propositions.statement: The effect to be expected is of the order 10 so that there is nearly 100 times to spare compared with the detected double refraction as a fraction of the whole refraction.
propositions.quote: The effect to be expected is of the order 10 , so that there is nearly 100 times to spare.

propositions.name: solids_also_no_double_refraction
propositions.statement: Even in solids there is no double refraction of the order to be expected due to motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: enough remains to justify us in concluding that even here there is no double refraction (of the order to be expected) due to motion through the aether.
